🐱✨ The Story of Bananas  🍌
Sometimes… some cats don’t wait for their life to change — they decide to change it themselves ❤️
This is the story of a little cat from the streets of Cairo who decided to start a new chapter of her life… and chose Sharm El Sheikh as her new home 🌴☀️
In a way nobody expected 😄
She went on an unusual journey… hiding inside a vegetable car traveling from Cairo to Sharm El Sheikh 🚗✨
And she arrived safely until she reached one of the hotels here.
The hotel team welcomed her with love and brought her to B-VET CLINIC for:
✅ A complete health check-up
✅ Health assessment and care
✅ Her required vaccinations
So she could start her new life healthy and safe 🩺🐾
After finishing her visit… she went back to the hotel, but this time she wasn’t a street cat searching for a place to survive…
She became a cat living in a five-star hotel 😎🏨
Happy, comfortable, and loved ❤️
And that’s how she got her name…
Bananas 🍌
Because her journey started in a funny and unexpected way… and ended with a completely different life 🐱✨
Not every cat needs a miracle… sometimes they just need someone to give them a chance ❤️
🐾

Meet Mini ❤️
For almost a year, Mini struggled with severe skin problems. Treatment after treatment was tried, but nothing seemed to bring lasting improvement.
When she came to us, we felt there had to be more to the story.
After a full workup and the right diagnostic tests, we finally found the real cause: Hypothyroidism.
At that point, Mini had lost almost all of her hair. Her skin was in terrible condition, and her family had been searching for answers for a very long time.
Once the correct treatment was started, everything began to change. Slowly, her skin healed, her coat grew back, and she started looking like herself again.
Today’s photo was actually taken by chance. ❤️
After being away traveling for some time, Mini came back and by chance i seen her at our B-Vet Pet Shop near the clinic today. Seeing her healthy, happy, and covered with a beautiful coat again brought a huge smile to our faces, and we couldn’t resist taking this photo.
The photos in this post are about one year apart, and they tell a story that words sometimes cannot.
Today, Mini is living a happy, healthy, normal life again. 🐾
We are incredibly happy for Mini and grateful to have been part of her recovery journey. ❤️
Because every patient deserves more than symptom control they deserve answers.
We couldn’t be happier for you, Mini. ❤️

Pyothorax recovery story 🫁❤️🐾
A rescued street cat from Delta Sharm arrived at our clinic a few weeks ago in critical condition. He was struggling to breathe.
During examination the cat showed severe respiratory distress. He was immediately put on oxygen and fluid therapy to help stabilize him enough to survive. Once he calmed down, X-rays and an ultrasound-guided needle test confirmed a large amount of fluid inside his chest. The sample showed pus. He was diagnosed with pyothorax, a severe and often fatal lung infection where pus fills the chest cavity, his chances of survival were very low.
He was rushed into surgery and under the proper anesthesia protocol a thoracostomy tube (chest drain) was placed to remove the infected fluid and help his lungs expand again. Because of the teams's quick response and skilled care he made an extraordinary recovery.
After weeks of drainage, antibiotics, and close monitoring, this brave cat is now breathing freely, eating well, and ready for a new home. In five days he’s due to be released back to the street so please contact us if you can offer him a forever home 💛
